line.t: You will ruin my name for that small family?
Your name was ruined the day you stole from my son.
Stole? I invested! The market crashed. It happens!
Then sell the car, Uncle. Today.
Mr Okafor, I came to apologise. I was wrong.
Madam, pride is an expensive habit. Who will pay for it?
I will. Please, don't punish our children for my sins.
Get up, my sister. Now let us talk like family.
Before you decide anything, open this.
